rooms.title: Jack / Clerk
rooms.copy: The clerk of the field. Unsigned slips, punch cards, a voice at the desk. He does not write canon.
rooms.signal: What happens as a result?
rooms.note: The desk. Punch cards. Not a chatbot.

rooms.title: Station XIII
rooms.copy: 51.46 °N, 3.19 °W. The public instrument of the Guild. It does not predict. It computes. The Ffilm is begun here.
rooms.signal: The machine does not predict. It measures relation.
rooms.note: The instrument. It does not predict. It computes.

rooms.title: Hub 2033
rooms.copy: Clockwork navigation for Station XIII. Eleven stations in free orbit. Drag, pinch, rotate, tap.
rooms.signal: Every station is local. The network is not.
rooms.note: The public front door. Mission, events, and the pathways in.

rooms.title: Chronometer
rooms.copy: Geocentric dial and orrery — Rose of Venus, syzygy thread, temporal throttle. Instrument №13 of the Guild.
rooms.signal: The machine does not predict. It measures relation.
rooms.note: Contemplative chronometer on the Guild plate. Civilian biwheel rebuild continues at chronometer.online.

rooms.title: Join
rooms.copy: Pop-up workshops that use the instruments of time travel — orreries, star-charts, oral history, film — to help people become makers of their own futures.
rooms.signal: Time travel isn't a destination. It's a way of reading where you stand.
rooms.note: Set your coordinates. Tell the Guild where and when you'd like to arrive.

rooms.title: Department of Excess Time
rooms.copy: An executive department established in 1951. It exists to safeguard the nation’s temporal welfare. The Department administers consequences. It does not create causes.
rooms.signal: Members of the public are encouraged to continue with their ordinary affairs.
rooms.note: Welsh Government. Established 1951. Serving Wales and the United Kingdom.

rooms.title: People
rooms.copy: The Guild is made of partial records. Each profile is one projection of a larger field. Thousands of partial biographies, affiliations, encounters and traces.
rooms.signal: The cast is the world. The world is not background.
rooms.note: No single person contains the whole story.

rooms.title: Watch
rooms.copy: Plates from the archive, set in orbit. Drag the picture to wind the reel; turn the brass to bend the light.
rooms.signal: The playhead moves like a body in an elliptical orbit.
rooms.note: Archive plates in orbit. Wind the reel, cut the light.

rooms.title: Feed∞
rooms.copy: Media, machine interpretation and encounter become field state, then the next state. Observation alters navigation.
rooms.signal: The next plate is chosen by what was seen, not by the clock.
rooms.note: A four-dimensional cultural navigation instrument. Residue survives. Raw hand movement does not.

rooms.title: Triangla
rooms.copy: The finger drum with three sides. Front, back, blueprint — an instrument you turn in the hands.
rooms.signal: Three sides. One stroke. The count holds.
rooms.note: The finger drum with three sides.

rooms.title: The Film
rooms.copy: A feature-length temporal event assembled across live performance, dome projection, testimony and recovered records.
rooms.signal: A film is a machine for remembering an event that has not yet happened.
rooms.note: The Ffilm is begun. Records, plates and witnesses are still arriving.

rooms.title: Commons
rooms.copy: The social layer: local chapters, witnesses, operators, travellers, archivists and accidental participants.
rooms.signal: No one enters the Guild alone, even when they arrive by themselves.
rooms.note: The room that holds the people who hold the Guild.

rooms.title: Calendar
rooms.copy: Observed conjunctions, departures, public sessions, Guild meetings, eclipse windows and unclaimed dates.
rooms.signal: Some dates are appointments. Others are coordinates.
rooms.note: The tree computes the next 120 days of sky. This chamber keeps the human dates beside them.

rooms.title: Archive
rooms.copy: Documents, minutes, photographs, reports, corrections and evidence that should not exist in the same timeline.
rooms.signal: Contradiction is not error. It is evidence of overlap.
rooms.note: Holdings are cited by catalogue mark. Some are on public deposit. Some are not.

rooms.title: Stations
rooms.copy: Physical sites and temporary embassies distributed through Wales and elsewhere. Each station keeps its own clock.
rooms.signal: Every station is local. The network is not.
rooms.note: Station XIII stands. Cribarth is reading. Other clocks are still being set.

rooms.title: Research
rooms.copy: Papers, falsifiable models, astronomical mechanics, narrative geometry and the mathematics beneath the instruments.
rooms.signal: Structure first. Interpretation later.
rooms.note: The arithmetic of Instrument №13, the drum, the tree’s axis.

rooms.title: Missions
rooms.copy: Small actions in ordinary places. Some are public. Some only become visible when several records are compared.
rooms.signal: A mission is a story with its destination removed.
rooms.note: Work in ordinary places. The record is the comparison.

rooms.title: Signals
rooms.copy: Audio fragments, coded broadcasts, public notices, machine outputs and transmissions without an agreed sender.
rooms.signal: Every signal is also an invitation to misread it.
rooms.note: A moment fixed by the sky, sent to nobody in particular, in the cause of peace.

rooms.title: Elsewhen
rooms.copy: Pages not yet attached to a stable chronology. Some may belong to 2033. Some may only appear to. Unplaced lights from 2014, 2019, 2031 live here until somebody claims them.
rooms.signal: Elsewhen is not another time. It is time without permission.
rooms.note: The furthest thing currently claimed, and the unsigned hours still burning.

rooms.title: On the Founding at Cardiff
rooms.copy: Third revision. An archival note on the cross-temporal founding of the Time Travellers Guild at Cardiff. Where the Guild first wrote itself down.
rooms.signal: Everything below 2008 is root.
rooms.note: Where the Guild first wrote itself down. Everything below this is root.

rooms.title: The Door
rooms.copy: Knock. Three doors stand open. One is a room. One is an instrument. One is locked, and does not open for knocking — it opens for knowing.
rooms.signal: The Guild works by position, not by name.
rooms.note: The gated entrance. Two doors posted. The third assembled from the reading.

lights.name: The mythology
lights.note: Where the Guild first wrote itself down. Everything below this is root.

lights.name: Unplaced
lights.note: A light with an hour but no address. Left burning until somebody claims it.

lights.name: Station XIII
lights.note: 51.46 °N, 3.19 °W. The instrument runs here, and the Ffilm is begun.

lights.name: Cribarth
lights.note: The sleeping giant above the valley. Readings taken three nights running; the tables disagreed.

lights.name: The transmission
lights.note: A moment fixed by the sky, sent to nobody in particular, in the cause of peace.

lights.name: Unplaced
lights.note: A branch the Guild intends to stand on. Not yet an address.
